reason: Provides an in-process trigram index that accelerates agent code search while preserving grep-compatible results through exact verification and ripgrep fallback.

summaries.zh: 这是一个为编码代理提供高速代码搜索的插件，通过进程内三元组索引加速 grep 和 glob 查询，并在必要时回退到 ripgrep。
summaries.en: A coding-agent plugin that accelerates grep and glob searches with an in-process trigram index and falls back to ripgrep when needed.

capabilities: Indexes repository files for code search
Replaces agent grep and glob tools
Falls back to ripgrep for unsupported queries
Downloads and loads a platform-specific native addon during installation
